intent: Gen III evolved corrupted void shader for the same Redjack enemy: preserve prior treatment, deepen the void body, add structured branching conduits and layered fracture detail, strengthen the one-sided magenta fringe, and make the reactor feel actively unstable.

delta.lighting_override: Same high-contrast top-down lighting as Gen II; the reactor and corrupted rim may bloom harder.
delta.detail: Build directly on Gen II without changing geometry: make the hull read as a structured fractured-conduit network, with multiple branching circuit channels that follow the existing fuselage and wing planes, brighter nodes at major facet intersections, short broken secondary filaments, localized red-to-violet energy bleed, and a clearly layered reactor with a hot red/pink core and violet outer shell. Increase the one-sided magenta fringe and add small pixel sparks at a few fracture endpoints, but keep the silhouette, background, and dark body planes readable.

constraints: preserve the exact Redjack silhouette, reactor placement, wing geometry, engine blocks, scale, and orientation
use the existing Redjack red energy and pale red accent palette with violet as the corruption layer
one centered enemy on the same deep navy starfield treatment as Gen I and Gen II
Gen III must visibly build on Gen II rather than introduce a new material language
avoid: fractures that cross the reactor or erase the silhouette
